fusions.name: Levelling Pulse
fusions.desc: Brings a flattening pulse down on every enemy within 4 tiles, dealing 30 damage and ignoring armour, with a 50% chance to leave each [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Nail Set
fusions.desc: A tapping blow that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 20% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Square and Plumb
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 40% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Struck True
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
